listing.aiSummary: Salvages all debris within reach at once instead of one at a time.

description:
Salvage Magnet

I can't believe this is not in the base game!

The new salvage ability salvages all debris within reach instead of one at a time. Interacting with a derelict includes all derelicts within reach inside the salvage dialog.

Compatibility

Can be added mid-saveCan be removed mid-saveReleases are always compatible with previous ones

Credits

rolfosian - made the entire mod.WolframSegler - maintainer.
